settings.question: How fast is shipping, and where do orders ship from?
settings.answer: All orders are packed and dispatched directly from our regional US fulfillment centers. Standard delivery takes 3–5 business days. You will receive an automated tracking number via email the moment your package leaves our warehouse.

settings.question: What is the 90-Day Risk-Free Money-Back Guarantee?
settings.answer: We stand 100% behind the craftsmanship and durability of every tool we make. If you are not thoroughly satisfied with the performance of your purchase for any reason within 90 days of delivery, simply email us at support@tryzavelyn.com for a hassle-free refund.

settings.question: Are replacement parts or blades available for your tools?
settings.answer: Yes! We stock replacement blade packs, switch cords, extension accessories, and adapters for all our core tools. You can order them directly on our store or reach out to customer support anytime.

settings.question: Is checkout secure? What payment methods do you accept?
settings.answer: All transactions are 100% encrypted with bank-level 256-bit SSL security. We accept all major credit and debit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express, Discover), PayPal, Apple Pay, Google Pay, and Shop Pay.
